user.title: Connect Noise Explorer Hub
user.description: Sign in with the email and password used in Noise Explorer Hub. Pair the watch in the app first. This uses Noise's cloud service. The service may replace an existing app session.

error.invalid_auth: Sign-in was rejected (server code {error_code}). Check your account status in Noise Explorer Hub.
error.wrong_password: Noise rejected the password (code -101). Use your Noise Explorer Hub password.
error.unknown_email: Noise did not recognize this email account (code -103). Use the email registered in Noise Explorer Hub.
error.login_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts (code -123). Wait before trying again.
error.account_locked: Noise reports the account is locked after password errors (code -127). Check sign-in in Noise Explorer Hub.
error.invalid_session: Noise rejected the session (code -14). Update the integration and try again; this does not necessarily mean the password is wrong.
error.server_redirect: Noise requested another account server (code -400). This integration does not yet follow server redirects.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to Noise cloud. Check connectivity and try again.

abort.already_configured: This Noise account is already configured.
abort.no_watches: No paired watches found. Pair your watch in Noise Explorer Hub first.
abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the same Noise account as this integration.

init.title: Noise Explorer updates
init.description: Cloud reads do not force a GPS fix. Automatic location requests wake the watch and use battery. Use 0 to disable them, or at least 300 seconds. The Request location button works at any time.
